source_description: QA bug reward [normal] to Tim: work_session.py end announce body 把 manager 跟 workers 各算一筆 participant, 同 persona 雙 role 時 (e.g. meadow solo session manager+worker 都是 meadow) 渲染兩次 +N token (但 ledger 因 idempotency flag 只 fire 1 entry, 不算 double credit). 同時 cmd_start 沒擋 manager 同時在 workers list. Fix: (1) cmd_start 過濾 manager from workers + dedupe (2) cmd_end 走 unique persona participants list (3) spec §11 加 'Manager==Worker' edge + '早收工' governance entry. Zeta 從 meadow solo session screenshot 抓到 (2.4 min 顯示 @meadow +5 + @meadow +5). (ref: work-session-prototype-display-duplicate-participant)
